campus.hero.identity.content: H1 "Alpha <Campus>"; subtitle "<grade range> Private School in <City>, <State>" with the HubSpot grade range and the HubSpot city/state.
campus.hero.identity.source: HubSpot Programs (name, grade range, city, state); decision 2026-09-15 that HubSpot is the source of truth

campus.hero.ctas.content: CTA row: STAY IN-THE-KNOW, Attend an Info Session, Book a Call, Apply now. Each resolves to a reachable, campus-specific destination.
campus.hero.ctas.source: demonstrated-correct pages (44 of 44 carry the first three; 39 carry Book a Call)
campus.hero.ctas.ownerWhenMissing: campus admissions owner for destinations; Elementor owner for a missing button

campus.hero.book-a-call.content: A Book a Call control is visible on desktop, tablet and mobile (hero CTA row; the lower CTA row too where the page has book_a_call_2) and links to this campus's own HubSpot Program call_scheduling_link. A hidden or missing Book a Call, or a link that is not the Program's call_scheduling_link, is a finding. An agent shows (never hides) the book_a_call_* widgets when HubSpot has the link; when the Program has no call_scheduling_link, nothing changes on the page and the ask goes to the HubSpot Program owner. Named exceptions live in registry/campus-cta-exceptions.json (Dorado's destination).
campus.hero.book-a-call.source: docs/decisions.md 2026-10-06 (Rachel Goodlad, Slack 2026-10-06 14:40, in answer to Matt Barge: "Should Announced campuses have a Book a Call button?" "Yes, they should all have their own links"; tests/fixtures/decisions/recorded/2026-10-06-campus-page-requirements-2cd27dff.json)
campus.hero.book-a-call.ownerWhenMissing: website-agent-operator (widget text, link and visibility, wordpress-direct); HubSpot Program owner when call_scheduling_link is empty

campus.intro.status-sentence.content: The campus's enrollment-state sentence as the first sentence of the intro text widget, followed by the "Join us for an info session" paragraph. Enrolling: "Alpha <Campus> is open and enrolling." Waitlist (the campuses named in registry/campus-enrollment-state.json; MacKenzie Price, 2026-10-05): "Alpha <Campus> is open, and we’re accepting applications for our 2026–27 waitlist. Apply for future enrollment, and our admissions team will guide you through the next steps." verbatim. No other waitlist wording, and never both states at once. No launch-era wording anywhere on the page: Coming Soon, Coming Fall, Launching, Opening <season>.
campus.intro.status-sentence.source: HubSpot state Open (decision 2026-09-15); wording from exemplars Plano and Scottsdale; requirement catalog rule on stale launch copy

campus.intro.media.content: Intro card slot shows this campus's approved open-state media: the "<Campus> Open and Enrolling" card from the September 7 template set, or an approved campus video. Never a launch-era graphic, another campus's image, or unrelated footage.
campus.intro.media.source: registry/campus-open-media.json; requirement catalog rule on launch media and approved video

campus.team.content: Only approved current staff cards with exact name, public title, biography, photo and order. No placeholders or crossed photos. Order per campus.team.order.

campus.team.order.content: Team section order: the people present and involved at the campus come first. The Director of Admissions and the Dean of Parents (or Associate Dean of Parents) at the top (leadership row) because they are the most public-facing, not ranked against each other; then the head or lead guide and every other campus-present card (guides and campus staff in the carousel or row); the Head of Schools who appears across many campuses (Dr. Tasha Arnold) last in the Team section, after every campus-present card. A campus whose own head of school is campus-present (Brownsville, Paige Fults) keeps that person in the leadership row. A card in the wrong place is a placement defect owned by website operations, not a roster question for the campus.
campus.team.order.source: Origin: MacKenzie Price, website strategy meeting with Matt Barge and Yash Chitneni, 2026-09-25 (docs/decisions.md); tests/fixtures/decisions/recorded/2026-09-25-campus-page-requirements-4ab0267f.json (Director of Admissions and Dean of Parents at the top, the Head of School lower). Clarification: Matt Barge, Slack conversation with the website agent, 2026-09-30 (docs/decisions.md); tests/fixtures/decisions/recorded/2026-09-30-campus-page-requirements-5c8952a9.json (the Head of Schools who appears across many campuses goes last, after every campus-present card; a campus-present head of school stays in the leadership row). This is the team-layout standard the roster plans were waiting on (docs/headshot-binding.md).
campus.team.order.ownerWhenMissing: website-operations for placement; dean-of-parents, then head-of-schools for who holds each role
checks: tests/site-truth-report.mjs team cell: ordered means Director of Admissions and Dean of Parents first, campus staff, the shared Head of Schools last; misordered names the card out of place

The videos come from the registered guide-video source, never from a one-off upload.

Source of the videos: registry/sources.json campusGuideVideos (Chris Moss's spreadsheet of every campus guide video; unregistered, sheet id null).

campus.enrollment-state.content: Every apply control on the page agrees with the campus's recorded enrollment state. Waitlist: the top banner application button and the resources-section application buttons all read "Apply for [<segment>] waitlist". Enrolling: no apply control label and no page-owned copy mentions a waitlist. The intro card is the matching card (campus.intro.media).
campus.enrollment-state.source: MacKenzie Price 2026-10-05 (the 13 campuses); Yash Chitneni, same thread, the four coordinated page elements; registry/campus-enrollment-state.json
campus.enrollment-state.ownerWhenMissing: Website operations (Elementor copy); Yash Chitneni for the card
campus.enrollment-state.checks: page-check open-enrollment-state-controls; observer campus-enrollment-state-controls; campus.intro.media.current for the card
campus.enrollment-state.note: Measured in both directions. The state is four elements together: the intro sentence, the hero apply control, the resources apply controls and the intro card; a page carrying some and not others is a finding. Membership comes from the registry, not from the copy, because no HubSpot Program property records it yet.
